# Catalog Listing

## Summary
The catalog's packaging card: one Listing bundles an app or block's specs,
examples, screenshots, skills and install metadata into the unit the
catalog browses, installs and remixes. `AppListing` (same module) is the
app-flavored subclass.

## Example
```ts
import { Listing } from 'https://realms-staging.stack.cards/catalog/catalog-app/listing/listing';
```
A listing instance links its Specs and example instances relatively within
its listing folder; the install flow copies that closure into the target
realm.
